Jay (Japanese: ジョー Joe) is a character of the day who appeared in Bonnie for the Defense!. He is part of the self-appointed " Defense Force", together with Heidi and Kye. Jay is often the sensible one of the three, often providing useful information and has plenty of sweets stowed away in his pockets. As part of a running gag, he often corrects Kye who tends to mispronounce his words.

He and the other members initially disliked grownups, believing them all to be liars. This was because he, Heidi, and Kye once found an abandoned . They cared for it, but were caught by a teacher. The teacher promised them nothing would happen as long as they were being honest, and after providing an explanation the teacher took the Eevee away from them.

Later, after a thunderstorm occurred, Jay and his friends found traces of something dragging itself through the forest. They followed them and arrived at a lake where they met an injured Lapras. Although it appeared scared at first, the children quickly gained its trust and promised to protect it by forming the Lapras Defense Force.

In the present day, Jay and his friends stopped , who was taking a stroll through the forest. Although he, Heidi, and Jay did not want anyone to know about Lapras because of the danger of Pokémon poachers, they inadvertently told Bonnie about Lapras when they introduced themselves as the Lapras Defense Force. When Bonnie heard Lapras's cry, they decided to introduce her to it. While the children played, Bonnie noticed Lapras was feverish and suggested the Defense Force get someone to help, but Jay and the others were skeptical and feared for Lapras's safety. They were found by , , and , who echoed Bonnie's concerns that they get a Nurse Joy to help Lapras recover. Jay and the others started crying out of guilt, and they decided to call in Nurse Joy.

Nurse Joy healed Lapras and informed the children that the Eevee their teacher had taken away from them had been brought back safely to its Trainer, causing Jay and the others to rethink their opposition to adults. After healing, Lapras started to cry out to the sky, and Clemont figured it had been separated from its friends, who were likely out at sea. After Bonnie had a word with the Lapras Defense Force, they decided that if they really loved Lapras, they would return it to its natural habitat. Later, he, Heidi, Kye, and Bonnie returned Lapras to sea safely while Ash, Clemont, and Serena battled . The Lapras Defense Force said goodbye to Lapras as reunited with its friends, and hoped they would meet it again someday. The day after, Jay, Heidi, and Kye said goodbye to Ash and his friends.

He reappeared in a flashback in Till We Compete Again!.
